mintAuthority.summary: MONEY has independent native crvUSD-style CDP issuance on Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism: users deposit approved collateral (WBTC, ETH, etc.) and mint MONEY against per-market debt ceilings using defi.money's controller/LLAMMA design; the defi.money admin Safe controls market onboarding and native risk parameters. LayerZero OFT transfer machinery is assessed separately in Bridge Risk.

controls.label: defi.money market controllers (crvUSD-style minter)
controls.capDescription: At Arbitrum block 495410695, MONEY is minted only against overcollateralized loans in defi.money markets under the 100,000,000 MONEY global ceiling and market-specific debt parameters; supply tracks collateralized borrowing, not an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495410695, the official deployment registry's MainController address was code-bearing and approved as a MONEY minter; STABLECOIN() returned the MONEY token, total_debt() was 1,108.978117087481937268 MONEY, get_market_count() returned 7, and global_market_debt_ceiling() returned 100,000,000 MONEY. MainController.create_loan deposits collateral, creates the loan, checks the debt ceiling, and calls MONEY.mint; this is native CDP issuance, not bridge representation minting.

controls.label: defi.money admin Safe (MONEY token owner)
controls.capDescription: defi.money 3-of-7 Safe owns the Arbitrum MONEY deployment and controls native market onboarding, debt ceilings, and risk parameters; its LayerZero peer, pause, options, and delegate powers are separately authored under Bridge Risk.
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495412172, Safe API and on-chain reads confirmed Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2, threshold 3, 7 owners, no enabled modules, and zero guard. At the native MONEY deployment, the Safe's token ownership and controller administration can authorize native market controllers and raise debt ceilings; its separate LayerZero peer, pause, options, and delegate powers are Bridge Risk, not global Mint Authority bridge capability.

controls.evidence: At Optimism block 155676732, Safe API and on-chain reads confirmed the same Gnosis Safe v1.3.0+L2 3-of-7 state as the other native deployments. The Safe controls native market onboarding and debt ceilings through the Optimism controller; its separate LayerZero peer, pause, options, and delegate powers are Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: At Arbitrum block 495410695, the MainController approved the MONEY token as its minter and reported 7 markets, positive total debt, and a 100,000,000 MONEY global debt ceiling; equivalent native reads were confirmed at Optimism block 155676713 and Base block 50081434. Safe reads at Arbitrum block 495412172, Optimism block 155676732, and Base block 50081448 confirmed the same 3-of-7 Safe with 7 owners, no enabled modules, and zero guard. EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots for the token and controller were zero at Arbitrum block 495419385, Optimism block 155677632, and Base block 50082350, confirming immutable native mint logic. The Safe can authorize controllers and raise native debt ceilings without an independent delay; LayerZero OFT bridge mint/burn, peer configuration, pause, and message validation are separate Bridge Risk machinery.
